ToolDefinition.Name: Get Performance Trace
ToolDefinition.Hint: Download performance trace from target via GDB
ToolDefinition.Description:
Connects to a remote target using GDB and downloads a memory region containing performance trace data. The downloaded binary data is saved to a MIAB file for later analysis.
Settings: Log address – Memory address where the trace log is located (default: 0xDEADBEEF) Log size – Size of the trace log in bytes (default: 1024) Target address – Remote target address for GDB extended-remote connection (e.g., localhost:3333) GDB binary – Path to the GDB binary to use (default: gdb-multiarch) Output file name – Name of the output MIAB file (default: trace.miab)
